high_level_description: The image is a promotional poster for an event celebrating the centenary of Raj Kapoor, titled "Raj Kapoor 100." The poster has a vibrant yellow background with a large red circle in the center, which features a black-and-white photograph of Raj Kapoor smiling. The text at the top reads "R.K. Films, Film Heritage Foundation and NFDC - National Film Archive of India present Raj Kapoor 100." Below the central image, there is a smaller illustration showing a clown and several people dressed in formal attire, suggesting a theatrical or celebratory theme.
